Use a conventional commit title in plain language, such as "fix(messageLogger): deleted messages no longer flicker".
Solve one problem per PR.
-->

## Problem

<!-- Explain the problem in a sentence or two. Include expected behavior and how to reproduce it where relevant. -->

## Change

<!-- Explain how this fixes the problem. If it touches several plugins or the core, say why they belong in the same fix. -->

## Verification

<!-- Describe the checks you ran and what you saw. State anything you could not check. "vp check passes" alone is not enough.

If you added or changed a patch or webpack find, run `vp run report` and say whether it was clean on stable and canary.
For UI changes, include before/after screenshots, and a short recording when motion or timing matters.
Upload evidence to GitHub and embed or link it here. Never commit PR-only assets. -->

<!-- If you used an agent, end with the model and harness that did the work. -->
